note: Single source of truth for the Command Index and Mars Intelligence's UI guide. Every entry needs a handler in features/registry.js (enforced by a unit test).

commands.label: Search Mars place
commands.description: Search the 2,052 USGS/IAU named features.
commands.how: Type in the search box at the top center and pick a suggestion.

commands.label: Select any coordinate
commands.description: Select an exact latitude/longitude by clicking the 2D map, the 3D globe or the global dust map.
commands.how: Click anywhere on the colored global map (outside route mode).

commands.label: Save current place
commands.description: Store the selected location as a custom place.
commands.how: Select a site, then choose Save current place.

commands.label: Add Safe Haven
commands.description: Mark the selected location as a user-defined Safe Haven (planning retreat point, not certified safe).
commands.how: Select a site, then choose Add Safe Haven.

commands.label: Sync USGS scientific map
commands.description: Center the USGS SIM 3292 scientific map on the selected site.
commands.how: Select a site; the USGS map syncs automatically, or run this command to re-sync.

commands.label: Toggle route mode
commands.description: When on, clicks on the 2D map or 3D globe add waypoints instead of selecting sites.
commands.how: Turn on route mode, click waypoints, then Analyze.

commands.label: Add selected site as waypoint
commands.description: Append the currently selected site to the route.

commands.label: Analyze route
commands.description: Compute the haversine distance and the MOLA terrain at each waypoint.

commands.label: Save route
commands.description: Save the analyzed route. Saving starts an along-track MOLA evaluation (MIN/MEAN/MAX elevation, slope, roughness, profile).
commands.how: Analyze a route with at least two waypoints, then Save route and name it.

commands.label: AI Route Designer
commands.description: Deterministic multi-objective route candidates (EVA, terrain, science, operational) over NASA MOLA terrain.
commands.how: Set a start and a destination, adjust objective weights, Generate, then Apply a candidate.

commands.label: Compare saved routes
commands.description: Side-by-side comparison of up to four saved routes: map, elevation profiles, along-track MIN/MEAN/MAX table with best and worst marked, per-route and combined USGS snapshots, CSV/JSON export.
commands.how: Save at least two routes, then Compare saved routes (also available from the 3D toolbar).

commands.label: Show saved routes on 3D globe
commands.description: Open the 3D view with the ROUTES panel: every saved route drawn in its color, with show/hide, fly-to, add-to-compare and USGS snapshot.

commands.label: Route Projection
commands.description: Open the 3D globe in projection mode: tick saved routes and each one is projected bold, lifted above the terrain with its name; the camera reframes to show every projected route.

commands.label: USGS route snapshot
commands.description: USGS SIM 3292 geology over MOLA hillshade with the geologic units crossed. With two or more routes selected for comparison, all of them are drawn together in one frame.
commands.where: Top bar, USGS map panel, 3D toolbar

commands.label: Save AI route candidates
commands.description: Save every AI Route Designer candidate as a named, reproducible route (single candidates: SAVE AS ROUTE on each card).

commands.label: Verify route reproducibility
commands.description: AI routes: replay the stored generation request and compare geometry vertex by vertex. Manual routes: re-run the deterministic MOLA evaluation and compare the statistics.

commands.label: Re-evaluate saved routes
commands.description: Re-run the along-track MOLA evaluation for every saved route (for example after the backend was offline).

commands.label: Mars Intelligence assistant
commands.description: AI assistant for this mission, Mars science, missions and history, and how to use NeuroNexus. Shows the tools it used and its sources; optional web search.

commands.label: Site hazard & evidence assessment
commands.description: Environment assessment status, warnings and data links for the selected site.

commands.label: Site science & habitability
commands.description: Material and habitability context for the selected site.

commands.label: Dust scenario graphs
commands.description: Modeled NASA Ames MY34 dust: opacity over all 668 sols, dust-top height, global dust map and the sol scrubber.

commands.label: Play / pause sol animation
commands.description: Animate the console sol through Mars Year 34.

commands.label: Jump to the site's dustiest sol
commands.description: Set the sol to this site's MY34 opacity peak (the 2018 global dust storm).

commands.label: Site morphology statistics
commands.description: Elevation, slope and roughness AT SITE plus MIN/MEAN/MAX over a 2, 4, 10 or 20 km MOLA window.

commands.label: THEMIS thermal evidence
commands.description: Historical NASA THEMIS brightness temperatures near the site (nearest value, min/max/mean, seasonal coverage).

commands.label: 3D Mars globe
commands.description: ArcGIS SceneView in Mars 2000 coordinates with terrain, geology, landing sites, rover traverses, exploration zones, overlays and saved routes.

commands.label: Potential exploration zones
commands.description: Candidate human exploration zones and regions of interest in the 3D view.

commands.label: USGS scientific map
commands.description: Scroll to the USGS SIM 3292 scientific map panel.

commands.label: Crewed Mars console
commands.description: Mission profile, crew, EVA, life support and resources (derived and simulated planning state).

commands.label: Orbital tracking
commands.description: Live NASA/JPL near-Mars small-body close approaches. Awareness only, not impact predictions.

commands.label: NASA Mars reference feed
commands.description: Recent NASA Science Mars items.

commands.label: Export mission JSON
commands.description: Everything: selection, environment, routes, candidates, console state, provenance.

commands.label: Export route CSV
commands.description: Per-waypoint table of the active or saved route.

commands.label: Export route comparison CSV
commands.description: Every saved route's along-track statistics.

commands.label: Data provenance ledger
commands.description: Every dataset NeuroNexus uses, with its source and evidence class (download as JSON).

commands.label: Field notes & checklist
commands.description: Persistent mission objective notes and a ten-item checklist (stored in this browser).

commands.label: Keyboard shortcuts
commands.description: Ctrl/Cmd+K opens the Command Index anywhere. Single-key shortcuts work when no text field is focused.

commands.label: Backend status
commands.description: Whether the NeuroNexus backend (FastAPI, port 8002) is reachable.

commands.label: About NeuroNexus
commands.description: Project purpose, data sources and the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026 context.

commands.label: Meet the Team
commands.description: Team NeuroNexus on the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026 site.

commands.label: Switch GLOBAL CONSOLE / MARSWALK
commands.description: Meter-scale EVA planning on the HiRISE → CTX → MOLA terrain ladder.
commands.how: Press M or use the mode switch in the top bar.

commands.label: Gale Crater Marswalk demo
commands.description: Plan a 4-hour EVA from Curiosity's latest position to a target 1.2 km west, at 1 m.

commands.label: Mission Operations Manual
commands.description: Quick starts, guides, live data status, the source ledger and Browser Optimization.

commands.label: Source ledger
commands.description: Browse, filter and export the canonical source ledger every source tag resolves to.
commands.where: Footer → SOURCE LEDGER, any tag → View in ledger

commands.label: Browser Optimization
commands.description: OFF by default (MAX FIDELITY). Turn it on for 4 GB RAM or low-end devices: worker math, IndexedDB tile cache, WebGL suspension and canvas culling, with live FPS and memory telemetry. Numbers never change.
commands.where: [MENU] → Browser Optimization, top-bar [PERF] pill, or the Radial Feature Wheel

commands.label: Global console
commands.description: Return to the global mission console (2D map, USGS geology, dust and THEMIS panels).
commands.where: Top bar → GLOBAL CONSOLE · Radial Feature Wheel (double right-click)

commands.label: Rover replay
commands.description: Turn on Curiosity's traverse and play the active sol forward: the rover marker moves to where Curiosity was at each MY34 sol.

commands.label: Terrain ladder: full (HiRISE 1 m)
commands.description: MARSWALK terrain ladder HiRISE → CTX → MOLA, 1 m where HiRISE exists.
commands.where: MARSWALK → TERRAIN LADDER · Radial Feature Wheel (double right-click)

commands.label: Terrain ladder: CTX + MOLA (20 m)
commands.description: MARSWALK without HiRISE: CTX 20 m, MOLA beyond.
commands.where: MARSWALK → TERRAIN LADDER · Radial Feature Wheel (double right-click)

commands.label: Terrain ladder: MOLA only (463 m)
commands.description: MARSWALK on MOLA 463 m only, to see what coarse terrain hides.
commands.where: MARSWALK → TERRAIN LADDER · Radial Feature Wheel (double right-click)

commands.label: Slope baseline overlay
commands.description: MARSWALK slope overlay at the rung's baseline (3 m on HiRISE).
commands.where: MARSWALK → OVERLAYS · Radial Feature Wheel (double right-click)

commands.label: Layer: topography
commands.description: Toggle HiRISE DTM footprints over the MOLA basemap.
commands.where: LAYERS ▾ → Topography · Radial Feature Wheel (double right-click)

commands.label: Layer: geology
commands.description: Toggle IAU named features and focus the USGS SIM 3292 geologic map.
commands.where: LAYERS ▾ → Geology · Radial Feature Wheel (double right-click)

commands.label: Layer: atmosphere / dust
commands.description: Toggle the MY34 dust optical depth tint (follows the active sol).
commands.where: LAYERS ▾ → Atmosphere · Radial Feature Wheel (double right-click)

commands.label: Layer: ground truth
commands.description: Toggle Curiosity and Perseverance traverses and waypoints (NASA MMGIS).
commands.where: LAYERS ▾ → Missions · Radial Feature Wheel (double right-click)

commands.label: Toggle map legend
commands.description: Show or hide the legend for the active layers.
commands.where: MAP LEGEND ▾ · Radial Feature Wheel (double right-click)

commands.label: Active sol scrubber
commands.description: Focus the top-bar ACTIVE SOL slider; every panel follows it (arrow keys step one sol).
commands.where: Top bar → ACTIVE SOL · Radial Feature Wheel (double right-click)

commands.label: RAD and weather conditions
commands.description: Open MARSWALK conditions: archived RAD dose rate, REMS outreach line, dust and solar geometry at the active sol.
commands.where: MARSWALK → CONDITIONS · Radial Feature Wheel (double right-click)

commands.label: Gale validation
commands.description: MARSWALK at Gale with the V1–V7 validation scorecard.
commands.where: MARSWALK → VALIDATION · Radial Feature Wheel (double right-click)

commands.label: Jezero validation
commands.description: MARSWALK at Jezero (out-of-sample) with its validation scorecard.
commands.where: MARSWALK → VALIDATION · Radial Feature Wheel (double right-click)

commands.label: Verify plan
commands.description: Re-run the current MARSWALK plan and compare plan_ids (same request + data versions → same plan).

commands.label: Export EVA brief (JSON v4)
commands.description: Server brief (schema-checked) + plan + conditions at the active sol + provenance.
commands.where: MARSWALK → EXPORT BRIEF · Radial Feature Wheel (double right-click)

commands.label: Export route GeoJSON
commands.description: Route LineString, one LineString per segment with its attributes, and the turnaround point.
commands.where: MARSWALK → EXPORT GEOJSON · Radial Feature Wheel (double right-click)

commands.label: Export CSV profile
commands.description: Along-route profile table with a provenance header.
commands.where: MARSWALK → EXPORT CSV PROFILE · Radial Feature Wheel (double right-click)

commands.label: Export validation report
commands.description: Gale and Jezero V1–V7 as JSON and Markdown, plus the chart PNGs.
commands.where: MARSWALK → VALIDATION · Radial Feature Wheel (double right-click)

commands.label: Command index
commands.description: Every capability of the console, searchable.
commands.where: Top bar → index icon (Ctrl/Cmd+K) · Radial Feature Wheel (double right-click)

commands.label: Radial Feature Wheel
commands.description: Tactical HUD ring: double right-click anywhere (Shift + right-click keeps the browser menu). W opens it at the center.
